narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Shop Window"**

A product company played straight, at the craft level of Linear, Stripe, Apple and 37signals. The page is a clean window and the products are what is in it: real screenshots of four live products, each sitting in its own faint wash of that product's colour. Everything around them (type, buttons, hairlines) is ink on near-white paper, quiet enough that the screenshots carry the colour and the interest.

Density is calm and generous: large tight-tracked headlines, an 18px reading size, wide section rhythm, and very few elements per view. The world is light-only by design: products are used in daylight, at counters and in shops, so there is no dark theme. The company itself has one accent, cobalt, and spends it on actions and links.

Confirmed rejections: glow blobs, a dark AI hero, fake div-built product UIs, eyebrows and kickers, rows of identical feature cards, gradients as decoration, and client-services language anywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Real product screenshots in hairline frames are the only imagery.
Ink on near-white paper; cobalt is the single company accent.
Each product owns its colour, used only inside its own tile.
Mona Sans everywhere, tight negative tracking on display sizes.
Full-pill buttons, 16px tiles and frames, 28px large surfaces.
One staggered rise on entry, one tile lift on hover; static under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only company accent. No second accent, no accent-coloured headings, no accent backgrounds on large areas.

rules.name: The Own Colour Rule
rules.body: A product colour appears only inside that product's own tile or product page, at a wash, never as a fill behind company UI and never on another product.

rules.name: The Daylight Rule
rules.body: Light theme only. Do not add a dark mode or a dark hero; ink is reserved for buttons and the logo reversal.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: A heading stands alone. No eyebrow, kicker, overline or small uppercase label above any heading, and no uppercase tracked labels anywhere.

rules.name: The Real Sequence Rule
rules.body: Numbers appear in front of items only when they are a real ordered sequence the reader follows (product "Step 1, 2, 3"). Sections are never numbered.

rules.name: The Plain Punctuation Rule
rules.body: No em or en dashes in copy. Use a full stop, a colon or a comma.

rules.name: The Soft Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, negative-spread and tinted. No hard offset shadows, no glow, no coloured halos.

rules.name: The Clear Glass Rule
rules.body: The fixed header is the one translucent surface (paper at 80% with a 12px backdrop blur, falling back to 95% paper). No other glass panels or frosted cards.

dos: **Do** let real product screenshots, in product frames, be the only imagery on the page.
**Do** use ink pills for the main action on paper and pair them with an outline pill for the second.
**Do** tint each product tile with only that product's colour at 6%, deepening to 10% on hover.
**Do** separate sections with a hairline and generous padding (80px, 112px from sm) rather than with coloured bands.
**Do** keep headings in Mona Sans 600 with the display tracking from the scale, left-aligned and width-capped.
**Do** keep entrance motion to the one staggered rise and the tile lift, and make both static under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** put an eyebrow, kicker or small label above a heading.
**Don't** number sections; number only a real step sequence.
**Don't** use em or en dashes in copy.
**Don't** use gradients as decoration, glass or frosted panels (beyond the header), glow, or hard offset shadows.
**Don't** introduce a second accent colour or use a product colour outside its own tile or page.
**Don't** build fake product UIs from divs; capture the real product.
**Don't** add a dark theme or a dark hero.
**Don't** use client-services language (agency, services, pricing packages, "we build for you"); wohnmohr is a product company.
